top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director's files is incomplete and does not have proof of orientation, DL/ID, pre-affidavit, nor an signed affidavit.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation no longer has  a fenced outdoor area.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.

top_violation_types.title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A report was not made to Child Care Regulation for an incident that potentially posed a risk to children.

top_violation_types.title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The incident report was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation made changes to the outside playground area and did not notify Child Care Regulations, that the changes were completed. Children were observed playing on the new play equipment.   The operation did not notify Child Care Regulations that they were moving classrooms and using one room that was unlicensed space.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room (26 TAC §746.2805(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver locked children in the bathroom and turned the lights off.
